As part of your enablement of AWS Cost Explorer, we have configured AWS Cost

innovation. It uses advanced machine learning models to detect and alert on
anomalous spend patterns across your deployed AWS services. The cost monitor and
daily email alert subscription we set up for you are free. You can change the
default configuration via our console or API to customize the alerts you
receive. You can also configure immediate alerts via SNS, though additional
charges for using SNS may apply.

account with an AWS Services monitor
